name: Wizard OS 0.3.69 — Connection apps stay current after an upgrade
about: Upgrading now brings installed default apps to the versions included with your Wizard update, including Claude. Backup restore no longer encounters a Claude app left behind by an earlier update. Existing connection settings and sign-ins are kept. This Latest release keeps the other components from 0.3.67; Stable is unchanged.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Fresh and alongside installs both take every default app at the source commit pinned below, and the Wizard UX and Agent Service images at the digests above; the installer reads back what runs (a default app on another source commit fails; index versions are informational and reported as drift). No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.

wizard-app-manager.note: 0.3.67 App Manager da2f01d1 plus only the independently reviewed installed-default release-pin fix from wizard-app-manager #267. Reconciles new required connection inputs without resetting owner settings; detects queued rollback by installed commit/version; projects installed metadata first. No backend/image input changes, unrelated main/Hermes changes excluded.

wizard-troubleshooter.note: Host tooling, no image: installed by `wam troubleshooter` as user systemd units (wizard-troubleshooter.service + wizard-guardian.timer, report-only) from exactly this commit; 4b1f0ef plus #10 (MIT license, no behavior change), #12 (one bounded owner-approved repair tool set shared by Claude, ChatGPT and Tinfoil; host-independent paths; no file/command grants without a per-box policy) and #13 (Claude falls back to the agent's second Claude sign-in when the Claude app login hits its usage limit).

wizard-agent-service.note: Official main through #151; preserves final #149 guards after #150 supersession.

wizard-ux.note: Official main merge of #569: Oscar Collins forward-ported Stable #567 (orb never freezes) and #568 (three-step guide), including the reviewed dictation and install-banner hold fixes. First main merge containing the complete Stable onboarding changes; later main work is not included.

wizard-app-manager.note: Official multi-arch main image from 80c76cf, workflow run 40171067383. Attestation reverified; all declared image inputs and workflow are byte-identical through 44fded38. Python backup engine is host-installed WAM source, not an image input.

shell.note: Alongside installs use the immutable official image above; index drift is informational.

ai-connection.note: Any number of ChatGPT subscriptions on the same accounts page as Claude (chatgpt-connection #3; engine ghcr.io/humanitylabs-org/wizard-chatgpt:0.2.4@sha256:1c90102e819574b4c5e0c50f782b3f7cd0e998b53415407471bf59dabca27418, amd64+arm64, built by wizard-app-store #32 at 254ee6f2, run 40364246353). Sign-ins run inside the agent (stock `hermes auth add openai-codex` through the wizard-os plugin broker) and land in its credential pool; the dialog names ChatGPT's 'Device code sign-in for Codex' setting before the code; an unreachable agent is reported with Retry and /api/connection answers unreachable instead of an empty inventory. Claude is installed by default as its own `claude-subscription` row below.

claude-subscription.note: Any number of Claude subscriptions (claude-connection #3; engine ghcr.io/humanitylabs-org/wizard-claude:0.2.6@sha256:5c7ca0b3b38803794aa3296f69bed11253a4136c26acded9f3298ed115580745, amd64+arm64, built by wizard-app-store #32 at 254ee6f2, run 40364246477). Added subscriptions sign in inside the agent (stock `hermes auth add anthropic`) through the wizard-os plugin broker; on alongside boxes the page never falls back to the original Claude Code login (it would not reach the host agent) and reports an unreachable agent with Retry; the original sign-in and an agent sign-in for the same account show as one row. Alongside with host Hermes on a claude-subscription provider: App Manager still binds the agent's own Claude Code login folder at the engine's /claude; tokens are never copied.

secrets.note: secret-drop #1: the engine image is pinned by its multi-arch digest (secret-drop:0.1.1@sha256:29ebc6a7…c03302), the same bytes as the 0.1.1 tag in 0.3.19.

hermes.test_record: none: carried over from 0.3.21, pinned before Wizard stable existed

notes: Latest only. All non-UX component, image and default-app pins, and the locked Hermes block, are exactly 0.3.66. App Manager da2f01d1 contains the backup bundle (44fded38 ancestry) and the installer repairs carried by Stable 0.3.65 (#258/#259, forward-ported as #260). The UX image is the official attested amd64+arm64 main build at 4b9264d3 (#569), carrying Stable #567/#568. Independent source/provenance checks are not full-release runtime acceptance: fresh install, upgrades from 0.3.39/0.3.40/0.3.65, backup/restore/Undo and first chat/phone pairing remain to be run on this exact release. No Stable promotion. Stock Hermes scheduler SQLite handling, exclusive AI-login handover, Tailscale re-enrolment and external-grant limitations remain unchanged.
